about: The named regions of the real app captures in public/screens, measured on the captures themselves (capture px, 1080 x 2346), for the covers' "detail" (the loupe: the capture's own pixels, enlarged) and "phone" (the tilted phone with a tag that sets the region's own words as type) compositions (src/cover/layout.mjs, design 2026-10-27, round 2 the same day). Each region: "box" [x, y, w, h] what the loupe draws; "element" [x, y, w, h] the whole UI element the box is part of (the outline on a phone follows it, concentric; the loupe rounds only the element's own corners and fades where its box cuts through the element); "radius" the element's corner radius; "key" [x, y, w, h] the short value or 2-3 words that prove the headline, "keyPx" its font size in capture px (its digits' cap height / 0.69), "text" the key as it reads, "keyRoom" [top, right, bottom, left] the free capture px round the key (a hand ring or underline that would run into the screen's own words is left out); for "phone" also "label" (the element's title) and "sub" (its grey line), as they read on the capture. COVER_ZOOM: the loupe enlarges a capture 1.6x at most (src/cover/layout.mjs SHARP), so keyPx x z >= 96 needs keyPx 60 or more; smaller app text goes on a "phone" tag, set as type. Add a region only after measuring it on the capture, and only on a capture verified against the current app (screens.json).
